data.name: Nausad
data.long_meaning: Nausad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘nausasya’, meaning 'lord of pleasure'. In Hindu mythology, Nausad is the name of the god of pleasures who is believed to grant desires and fulfill wishes. He is often depicted as a young, handsome, and charming deity who is fond of music, dance, and wine.
